managed_identities.exact_position_writer: Panda.ZGame.ZBattleUtils.SetSelectPoint(ZEntity, ESelectPosSource, ESkillTargetRangeType, ESkillSelectPointType, int, Quaternion, Vector3, bool)
managed_identities.normal_skill_consumer: Panda.ZGame.CharCtrlCompBase.UseSkill(int, SkillControlData, bool, bool, bool, bool, bool)

proven_static_flow: A non-default SetSelectPoint forcePos is written verbatim into host component id 0x6A, consistent with IndicatorPosComponent.
The normal UseSkill path supplies a default forcePos to SetSelectPoint and consumes the resulting host component position.
ZIndicatorMgr.FireSkill writes its private indicatorPos_ to the host before dispatching FirePlaySkillEvent with isIndicator true.

FirePlaySkillByIndicator resolves current SkillControlData and dispatches FirePlaySkillEvent with clearSlot true, isIndicator true, and isAIPress false without the ZIndicatorMgr.FireSkill position copy.
The indicator UseSkill path reads IndicatorPos, writes the selected XYZ into UseSkillParam.TargetPos, generates fresh action state, and continues through the normal server-owned skill path.

overwrite_hazard.conclusion: Staging exactForcePos before normal FlagSkill release is not preserved; the manager-owned indicator position overwrites it before skill dispatch.

candidate_not_activation_contract.benefit: The downstream normal skill path remains responsible for fresh skill/request/authentication/session/transport state.
blockers: ZSkillInputMgr is internal and no reviewed Lua wrapper exposes this method.
Safe acquisition, ownership, lifetime, and scene validation for the live internal instance are unproven.
A sanctioned main-thread bridge with the exact IL2CPP ABI and current PlayerEnt/PlayerSkillInputComp instances is unproven.
Atomicity and failure behavior between the position write and skill dispatch are unproven.
The all-zero world vector is treated as a selection sentinel and cannot be accepted as a portable exact marker until runtime behavior is proven.
No repository native bridge implements this sequence.
